gaps.sentence: The charity relies entirely on voluntary ___ (DONATE).
gaps.explanation: 'Voluntary donations' — gifts of money given willingly.

gaps.sentence: She was ___ (ABLE) to attend because of illness.
gaps.explanation: 'Unable to attend' — negative of able is unable.

gaps.sentence: Her ___ (ANALYSE) of the data took three weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'Analysis' is the noun for a detailed examination; an 'analyst' is a person.

gaps.sentence: The council rejected plans for a new ___ (DEVELOP).
gaps.explanation: 'A development' = a building project; 'developer' = the company.

gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (INFLUENCE) thinkers of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'Influential' describes a person who influences others.

gaps.sentence: The new ___ (GOVERN) takes office in May.
